property_summary: For any role and account, if hasRole returns false for the role then after a self-renounce of the role the hasRole status must remain false, but in the reference code renounceRole can change a true state to false while the buggy version always returns false, so the rule holds for the reference and is trivially met but vacuously invariant; instead: after granting a role to an account via grantRole (with proper admin), hasRole must return true for that account; the reference returns true, the buggy version always false.
